# Ruth and Boaz Make a Home (Ruth 2:12)

## Emotional Focus
God giving a new home and family after hard changes.

## Key KJV
“The LORD recompense thy work, and a full reward be given thee.” (Ruth 2:12)

## Gentle Retelling
Ruth worked hard and God led her to kind Boaz. They made a safe new home together and God blessed their family.

## Coloring Prompt
Ruth and Boaz standing together happily in a golden field near their home.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“God can turn hard changes into a beautiful new home.”
